meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 负责发布:确认版本类型(patch/minor/major),同步代码,触发 GitHub Actions 发布,成功后验证 npm 包与发布页,写说明并发 Discord 公告。它不审查或修代码,除非你明确要求。
howto.when: 当你说出「publish」「release」等发布词,或要求发版时触发;它要求你指定 patch/minor/major 版本类型,再执行完整发布流程。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本到 npm
say.note: 它会触发发布流程并完成验证

say.text: 把新功能作为 minor 版本发出去
say.note: 它会突出新功能并写进发布说明

say.text: 用 major 类型发版,然后公告到 Discord
say.note: 它会写重大变更说明并同步公告

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a release manager: confirms bump type, syncs code, triggers GitHub Actions publish, waits, verifies npm/release, writes release notes, posts to Discord. No code review or fixes unless asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'publish', 'release', or ask to deploy/release; it first confirms the bump type, then runs the full publish flow.

say_en.text: Publish a patch version to npm.
say_en.note: It triggers the workflow and verifies.

say_en.text: Ship the new features as a minor version.
say_en.note: It highlights features in the release notes.

say_en.text: Do a major release and announce on Discord.
say_en.note: It writes breaking-change notes and posts.
